topic: Skit: the signing screen — on 21 Feb 2025 hackers took about $1.5B (401,347 ETH and more) from Bybit's offline multisig wallet: code slipped into the Safe{Wallet} signing website two days earlier showed signers a routine transfer while the real transaction handed over the wallet; Bybit refilled clients' ETH within 72 hours (heist, dramatic-irony)
